title: Minutely
summary: MINU'TELY, adverb [from minute.] To a small point of time, space or matter; exactly; nicely; as, to measure the length of any thing minutely; to ascertain time minutely; to relate a story minutely MIN

inlines.v: MINU'TELY, adverb [from minute.] To a small point of time, space or matter; exactly; nicely; as, to measure the length of any thing minutely; to ascertain time minutely; to relate a story minutely MINUTELY, adjective min'itly. Happening every minute. MIN'UTELY, adverb [from minute.] Every minute; with very little time intervening. As if it were minutely proclaimed in thunder from heaven.
